wholeCurrentGoal.title: Siliconöle, Siliconharze und Siliconkautschuke strukturbezogen erklären

targetFit: The three family panels orient the whole selectedsilicone goal through chain/network→property/use. Unlinkedmobilechains/oilflow, densecrosslinkedresin/protectivehardcoating and sparsecrosslinkedrubber/deformableseal are coherent examples.

Oil flow, curedhardcoating and reversiblydeformableseal are selectedqualitative examples. This image does not promise universalhardness,temperaturestability,curemethod or manufacturingconditions for every silicone grade.
The image does not draw hydrolysis/cureequations or allsourceclauses; a correct corestructurepropertyorientation is sufficient and is not a wholeP/source demonstration.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Organische Farbmittel nach Kriterien einteilen

wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can introduce selected classes of organic colourants using explicitly named criteria and classify supplied representatives transparently. wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the mechanism of polyaddition at particle level using the reaction of hydroxyl and isocyanate groups, represent electron-pair shifts and proton transfer leading to the urethane linkage, and connect repeated group reactions of bifunctional starting materials to chain formation without elimination of a small molecule.
